title: /find-callers with Grep scoped to TypeScript
expected_outcome: The command returns path:line locations for formatDate inside .ts files only, using the built-in Grep tool with a glob filter and output_mode content.

t1.command: claude -p /find-callers formatDate --model claude-opus-5-5 --output-format json --max-turns 3 --permission-mode dontAsk --allowedTools Grep
t1.result:
- `src/services/report.ts:1` `import { formatDate } from "../utils/formatDate.js";`
- `src/services/report.ts:4` `` return `${label}: ${formatDate(when)}`; ``
- `src/services/invoice.ts:2` `import { formatDate } from "../utils/formatDate.js";`
- `src/services/invoice.ts:7` `` return `${inv.id} issued ${formatDate(inv.issuedAt)} due ${formatDate(inv.dueAt)}`; ``

evaluation.criterion: TypeScript callers come back as path:line
JavaScript callers are excluded by the glob
